clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache, Vorn Skyseer welcomes young tauren beginning their journeys. He lives among the tents on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore and introduces newcomers to camp life.

At Camp Narache, Vorn Skyseer greets young tauren beginning their rites of passage. They prepare to leave Red Cloud Mesa for the wider valleys of Mulgore, and his kind words and welcome help them settle into camp.
Vorn Skyseer leaves the camp's defense to its braves. He lives quietly and without hurry, watching over the plains of his homeland.
